== Course of events ==

Having set out with bread packed in her basket and wearing the silver shoes that had fit her perfectly, Dorothy travels through the pleasant Munchkin countryside. Resting by a cornfield, she comes upon a Scarecrow stuck on a pole, who winks and speaks to her.

Dorothy frees the Scarecrow from the pole. He joins her journey, hoping that Oz will give him brains.

Together they continue on, and Dorothy is later welcomed for the night by the wealthy Munchkin Boq, who takes her silver shoes and white-trimmed dress as signs that she is a friendly witch.
